patch_description: This approach builds a congestion-aware menu of two-hop routes. For each origin-destination pair, it distributes a bounded routing reward across candidate relays, favoring relays and constituent links with lower estimated traffic pressure. Direct links retain a separate service reward. Unlike a uniform two-hop bonus, the route rewards compete for a fixed per-pair budget, so adding more candidate paths does not inflate their total influence. The construction uses at most \(n(n-1)(n-2)\) quadratic terms.
